23. Read the passage and answer the question.
A new hearing device is now available for some hearing-impaired people. This device uses a magnet to hold the detachable sound-processing portion in place. Like other aids, it converts sound into vibrations, but it is unique in that it can transmit the vibrations directly to the magnet, and then to the inner ear, producing a clearer sound. The new device will not help problem in the middle ear. It will probably help no more than 20% of all people with hearing problems. Those people, however, who often have persistent ear infections should find relief and restored hearing with this device.
Who can get help from this device?
options: All people can get help from this device.
Only those who have ear infection.
Only those who have problem in inner ear.
Only those who have problem in middle ear.
Only those with a hearing loss caused by infection and other problem in inner ear.

questions.subject: ENGLISH(24)
questions.question:
24. A new hearing device is now available for some hearing-impaired people. This device uses a magnet to hold the detachable sound-processing portion in place. Like other aids, it converts sound into vibrations, but it is unique in that it can transmit the vibrations directly to the magnet, and then to the inner ear, producing a clearer sound. The new device will not help problem in the middle ear. It will probably help no more than 20% of all people with hearing problems. Those people, however, who often have persistent ear infections should find relief and restored hearing with this device.
Why is the device unique?
options: Because it gives sound directly to the inner ear.
Because it gives vibrations to the magnet.
Because it transmits sound faster to the ear.
Because it transmits vibrations directly to the magnet and then to the inner ear.
Because it takes little time to produce clearer sound.
